name: Z-Com, Inc.
summary: Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, Z-Com, Inc. specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of wireless networking solutions. The company's reach extends throughout Taiwan, Mainland China, Germany, and various international markets. Z-Com's product portfolio includes advanced wireless LAN controllers for carrier-grade, SMB, and industrial private network applications, as well as indoor and outdoor access points and Wi-Fi modules. Additionally, they provide 4G LTE cellular gateways and crucial accessories such as antennas, power adapters, and Power over Ethernet (PoE) injectors. Beyond hardware, Z-Com delivers comprehensive wireless solutions tailored for diverse needs, including new energy communication management, private networks, surveillance systems, hospitality, rural connectivity, in-vehicle Wi-Fi, smart campus environments, and carrier Wi-Fi offload. The company also offers expert system integration services for complex wireless communication infrastructures.
